paragraphs: He asks Rav Ashi a question in Nedarim 10a; Hyman writes that it seems the reading should be “son of Rava.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman’s supplied locator is Nedarim 10a, retained in the translation. The matching question of Acha son of Chiyya before Rav Ashi occurs in the William Davidson digital text of Nedarim 10b. “Son of Rava” remains Hyman’s tentative emendation, not an adopted genealogy.

Hyman supplies Nedarim10a. The saved Davidson10b scalar explicitly has Rav Acha son of Rav Chiyya questioning Rav Ashi;10a remains in the translation. The historical whole-10a nonmatch is a prior search claim, not a newly independently checked absence. Son of Rava remains Hyman’s tentative it-seems/should-be emendation, not an adopted genealogy. The saved digital passage is not inspected Vilna print.
